usableResult: A new user registers with a first system, becomes its super administrator, enters the system shell, and can later sign in and enter the same authorized system again.

engineering.authentication: Project authentication and permission interceptors; no Spring Security

generatedBoundary.responsibility: table-shaped persistence and generated CRUD only
generatedBoundary.frontendDependency: the product frontend does not call generated base controllers

businessBoundary.responsibility: one complete product action, validation, authorization, transaction and event orchestration
businessBoundary.ordinaryCallChain: controller -> use-case service -> generated IService -> generated ServiceImpl -> generated BaseMapper -> database
businessBoundary.specialPersistence: Only a named repository port may call a repository/JDBC adapter or custom mapper XML when the accepted data contract proves generated IService is insufficient.

engineering.sqlPolicy: New special SQL exists only behind a named repository or custom mapper XML; controller, manage, application and domain code must not add inline business SQL or inject BaseMapper.
engineering.complexityPolicy: Do not add a broad service that combines unrelated product actions; split by aggregate and action boundary.
engineering.legacyPolicy: Existing code and historical PASS evidence are reference material only. Reuse code only after it conforms to this phase contract; freeze unrelated legacy surfaces instead of extending them.

database.migration: A clean MySQL database migrates once with Flyway and a second check is non-destructive.

defaultAdministrator.idempotency: initialize once; repeated initialization neither duplicates the account nor resets an existing password
defaultAdministrator.secrecy: never emit the password in logs, responses or evidence

database.transactionBoundary: Registration plus first-system bootstrap is atomic.
database.passwordStorage: Passwords are never stored in plaintext.

requiredActions: read current account and platform context
switch into an enabled authorized system
api.responseRule: Every failure has a stable business code, a human-readable message and requestId.
api.authorizationRule: Frontend hiding never replaces backend authorization; a platform account without systemMemberId cannot enter system business pages. A disabled system denies ordinary members while an authorized system administrator receives ADMIN_SETTINGS_ONLY context.

explicitExclusions: organization and role administration beyond bootstrap super administrator
performance, capacity, million-record and concurrency testing
